about: Broken copies of examples/totals-01, a round whose seller published headline totals. Each copy changes the totals or the refund list and fails on the checks listed.

copies.name: 01-keeps-more-than-the-winners-paid
copies.story: The seller publishes that 3,500,000 was kept and 4,200,000 refunded. Both add up to the 7,700,000 received, but two winners at 1,500,000 pay 3,000,000, and 4,700,000 was refunded.

copies.name: 02-hides-a-payment
copies.story: Four payments reached the lot, one of them late. The seller publishes three, fewer than the three bids and the one late payment its own lists show.

copies.name: 03-totals-do-not-balance
copies.story: The seller publishes 7,800,000 received, 100,000 more than came in, so received no longer equals kept plus refunded.

copies.name: 04-refund-list-is-shorter-than-the-total
copies.story: The seller publishes the true total refunded, 4,700,000, but the refund list leaves out the 1,200,000 owed to the late bidder, so the books do not balance.
